basic_profile.bio: Hailing from Toronto, Canada, I've been an avid gamer and tech enthusiast since my early teens. I work as a software developer during the day and lose myself in the world of video games by night, particularly enjoying the Far Cry series and Super Robot Wars. I have a penchant for modding games like Minecraft, which often leads me to explore new plugins and tools. Despite my busy schedule, I make time for my side hobby of reading science fiction novels, especially the Expeditionary Force series. I tend to stay online mostly in the evenings, after 7 PM EST. Currently single, I'm open to connections with fellow gamers and tech geeks.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in computer science from the University of Waterloo, I've spent years honing my skills in software development, focusing on game development and plugins. I am self-taught in modding and have contributed to several open-source projects over the years, particularly in the Minecraft community.
